create_words_augmenter: create a WordsAugmenter instance with action, min_char, aug_word_min, aug_word_max, aug_word_p, and priority_words parameters
run_delete_augmentation: run the delete method on a WordsAugmenter to merge selected words with the following word in text
run_split_augmentation: run the split method on a WordsAugmenter to split selected words in two at a random position
test_delete_method: test the WordsAugmenter delete method by passing a sentence and verifying merged word output
test_split_method: test the WordsAugmenter split method by passing a sentence and verifying split word output
